source_route: NativeGoToZone: current-Level transition gate; normalize entry -1 to 0; QuickSave(false) in state 38; SG_SaveAllPlayer(false); resolve LevelList/file and player slot/difficulty; DisplayFastTravel; Application::LoadLevel(file,entry,slot,true,true,difficulty,false,0,0).

Application::LoadLevel(existing state 38): loading callback if required; Level+0x145=1; score; Level+0xf0=1; SG_SaveLocalPlayer(true); QuickSave(true); ResetIsLoaded; GSLevel::LoadLevel queues StateMachine::SwitchState.

Deferred StateMachine update pops old GSLevel before new state; old Level::Unload runs QuickSave(Level+0xf0), then SG_SaveAllPlayer(Level+0xf0), then cleanup. After ResetIsLoaded, the unload QuickSave state-38 gate skips.

Level constructor matches the LevelList row and creates a separate LevelSavegame using slot/hub/row/difficulty/checkpoint inputs. LevelSavegame owns Savegame at +4 with INFO and OBJS; Save dispatches saveAll when its source gate allows. This file is distinct from PlayerSavegame profile data.

selected_runtime.fresh_start: OriginalUiSession queues NativeStartGame; renderer applies the fresh-start plan and calls load_world. Source NativeStartGame returns early when current Level state is 38, so it is not the restart/fast-travel route.
selected_runtime.fast_travel: OriginalUiSession NativeGoToZone currently fails closed. level_transition_v1 and application_level_load_handoff_v1 model source order but have fixture providers only.
selected_runtime.current_level_binding: source_level_owner binds the renderer projection, selected LevelList fields, canonical PlayerSavegame and QEST. Its source identities are port facades, not a live source Level/GSLevel/LevelSavegame allocation; the level-save facade does not own a constructed per-level Savegame or publisher.
selected_runtime.NativeSaveGame: Routes to the active Character's canonical PlayerSavegame profile Transport. It cannot publish LevelSavegame INFO/OBJS.

smallest_missing_provider: One active Level lifecycle owner carrying the real reconstructed Level state and distinct per-level LevelSavegame/+4 Savegame identity, constructed from exact Level constructor inputs.
Source ObjectManager row snapshot and facts for each eligible object: +0x28 gate, name +0x5c, signed map key, type +0x64, Character/player/local flags, and +0x81 filter byte.
Exact virtual Serialize (+0x10) provider for every eligible object in the selected scene; current renderer descriptors are not source ObjectBase instances.
Per-level Savegame publisher bound to the original save directory and exact GetFilename arguments. PlayerSavegame Transport is not a substitute.
validation_scope: Hashes and order are static evidence for the pinned ELF. Host transition kernels validate call order with fixtures only; no live Android transition or source Savegame publication is established.
